countingRule: Count one disagreement for each reviewed atomic-activity card whose current response is disagree. Do not treat unreviewed cards as agreements, and do not double-count response revisions.
interpretation: Counts monitor expert disagreement. They are not an accuracy estimate or a causal comparison unless prompt, model, sample, and review conditions are held fixed.

rounds.notes: Rob characterized all three disagreements as minor. The Slack message ends with an incomplete clause, so no missing explanation is inferred.
